description: Post a job contract (POST /v1/jobs, signed by the buyer or provider). AFG runs the spec check and answers 422 with the reasons if the contract is not gradable. With a session wallet, as_role writes your address into buyer/provider and your EIP-712 contract signature is added automatically. Result: job in DRAFT (or AGREED if both signatures are present). Max 5 open jobs per wallet. TEST MONEY ONLY: mock ledger, test tokens (tUSDC), no real funds.
